name: Seq5 fixed-prompt-anchor ToMe diagnostic
purpose: Test whether using the initial prompted-object pointer when pairing spatial memory keys changes prolonged object-presence failures, while retaining SAM2's native presence and decoder behavior.

scope.role: post-hoc development diagnostic only; Seq5 informed this candidate
scope.prompt: Use the existing first-frame prompt unchanged
scope.frames: Full ordered propagation over all 249 post-prompt targets

method.mechanism: Within each frozen SAM2 memory-attention layer, compare spatial keys with the initial prompt pointer's keys after both pass through the same frozen K projection and SAM2 positional transform. Add this cosine cue to the existing local ToMe matching metric. Keep the pinned ToMe bipartite matcher and mass-weighted K/V aggregation.
method.quota_control: Use the prompt-anchor arm's per-frame, per-layer, per-window merge counts unchanged for same-frame-pointer and generic controls. Verify exact matched counts before interpreting outcomes.
unchanged: all 249 source frames and the native memory schedule
SAM2 parameters, memory writes, native attention projections, decoder and object-presence rule
ToMe window size and merge rate
forbidden: target ground-truth access during inference or matching
changing merge quotas after observing Seq5 results

primary: object-presence logits on GT-present zero-Dice intervals
returned-mask Dice on all GT-present targets
false alarms on all GT-empty targets
report.interpretation_limit: Seq5 is development data. Even if the prompt-anchor arm improves Seq5, this is a mechanism diagnostic only and cannot establish cohort efficacy or generalization. A new candidate requires a separately frozen multi-sequence protocol and untouched confirmation.

preconditions.active_full_cohort: PID 50946 must exit with a completion receipt; all 21 sequences must pass integrity audit before any diagnostic inference
preconditions.engineering_gate: Require gate v2 completion plus an independent replay receipt at prompt_anchor_seq5_diagnostic/gate_v2/independent_replay.json.
preconditions.source_integrity: verify pinned SAM2, ToMe, model, runner, checkpoint, manifest and archived-native hashes before inference
preconditions.failure_policy: Any failed precondition, parity check, budget check, or frame alignment check stops the diagnostic; no retry or silent protocol change.
preconditions.runner_gate: Use only a fresh Drive output directory; runner fails closed unless the frozen protocol is amended and hash updated after all gates pass.
preconditions.full_cohort_audit: Require an independently generated all-21-sequence PASS receipt at full_attempt01/audits/final_full_cohort_integrity_audit.json.

execution.reason: Full cohort completed and all 21 sequence integrity audits passed; prompt-anchor seq2/seq3 engineering gate passed in two independent processes with byte-identical outputs.

runner_integration: scripts/run_seq5_prompt_anchor_diagnostic.py (preconditioned; not yet eligible to run until active cohort and gate pass)
